citations.quote: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations. Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: ... malicious mischief or vandalism; ...

output.reasoning: The claimant states they found damage to the side of the car and do not know what happened, which aligns with 'malicious mischief or vandalism' or other non-collision events covered under the comprehensive (Other than collision) section. There are no facts provided in the claim to trigger any of the listed exclusions (such as commercial use, racing, or unlicensed drivers).
